items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And what we got to do before we can cut, we got to teach Freddie the tune.

ctx.x: He used to call it, used to call it futuristic, instead of calling it progressive or modern like they call it now, they used to call it futuristic music. And if you play it that way, you know, you, uh, you ahead of time. Used to try to, 된 stuff with stuff stuff with stuff with stuff

It involved arrangements and all kind of interludes and things like that. Sidney Arden was hella on that. He always had to have a cadenza at the end of the tune, you know. It's a funny story, Bill, when we were making those recordings. We had one of those tunes there. We get to the end of it and there's a clarinet cadenza. Well, when we made them, I had an infected toe, so I was using a stick. See, in a shoe, open shoe like this. And I had one of those big Chinese gongs, you know. So I had to hit one lick before…
What tune was that you used the dong on?
